name: Adaptive Multiresolution Extraction with Oracle
aliases: Adaptive Surface Reconstruction with Oracle-based LOD
definition: A technique that adaptively extracts meshes from coarser-resolution nodes to gain speed, using an 'oracle' structure to manage level of detail and patch cracks at resolution junctions.
summary: Adaptive Multiresolution Extraction with Oracle is a technique that extracts crack-free meshes from octrees by using an oracle to manage level of detail and patch junctions.
